## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Jùshě Lùn Sòng Shū Yì Chāo* 俱舍論頌疏義鈔 (CBETA X53n839) is a Tang dynasty 3-juan sub-commentary (*chāo* 鈔) on 圓暉's *Jùshě lùn sòng shū* ([KR6l0036](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6l/KR6l0036), T1823), composed by the monk Huìhuī 慧暉 ([慧暉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E6%9A%89), Tang), a student of 圓暉. The title *yì chāo* 義鈔 indicates "doctrinal extracts" — selected passages from 圓暉's text with additional explanation. The CBETA edition preserves the text in 3 juan with a table of contents.

**Abstract**

Huìhuī 慧暉 (fl. mid-to-late 8th century CE), styled Tang Abhidharma monk, was a student of 圓暉 ([圓暉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%9C%93%E6%9A%89)) who lived at Xīmíngsì 西明寺 in Chang'an. He composed this sub-commentary (*yì chāo*) as doctrinal annotations on 圓暉's commentary, focusing on clarifying the most difficult passages. Like his fellow student 遁麟's *Jùshě lùn sòng shū jì* ([KR6l0041](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6l/KR6l0041)), this text belongs to the second-generation transmission of 圓暉's *Sòng Shū* commentary tradition.

This Tang Abhidharma master Huìhuī is entirely distinct from the Southern-Sòng Cáodòng Chán master of the same name 慧暉 (1097–1183) represented in the existing *yǔlù* tradition.
